title: Hatch, annotation, dimension and inspection
objective: Implement the next bounded AutoCAD-class capability for hatch, annotation, dimension and inspection workflows across Golden workflows G1/G4/G6/G8 while preserving frozen Architecture v1.1 and existing canonical CAD semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Hatch entities and patterns have deterministic canonical identity, ownership/provenance, boundary semantics, serialization and rendering/selectability within the bounded roadmap scope.

Supported hatch creation and edits are validated before mutation, commit through the canonical CADDocument/Construction Graph path, and integrate with existing undo/redo without orphaned or phantom entities.
Annotation/text semantics needed by G1/G4/G6/G8 are deterministic, canonical and render/select correctly across supported views without introducing a separate application authority.

Dimension creation, editing and measurement presentation required by the assigned workflows are deterministic, canonical and revision-backed, with invalid/unsupported inputs rejected using the existing typed error taxonomy before mutation.
Inspection behavior required by the assigned workflows is explicit, deterministic and bounded; it must not silently expand into the later OSNAP/OTRACK/tracking scope.
Deletion and invalid/unsupported cases have deterministic behavior and cannot create hidden canonical state or orphaned entities.
Web and Electron execute the same engine-free semantic command path and converge on equivalent affected serialized state.
Verified predecessor behavior from COMPAT-CAD-005 through COMPAT-CAD-009 remains regression-green; no previously verified invariant is weakened.
Exact-target deployment and independent black-box browser verification cover G1, G4, G6 and G8, including relevant negative/error paths.
Architecture v1.1, Construction Graph authority, CADDocument semantics and EngineAdapterBundle boundaries remain unchanged unless a separately approved ACR authorizes an architecture change.
No benchmark score increase is claimed unless the complete CAD-BENCH-RW-001 corpus is rerun and measured.
non_goals: No durable SAVE/OPEN or multi-instance persistence; COMPAT-CAD-011 and infrastructure own that work.
No DXF import/export; COMPAT-CAD-012 owns that work.
No layout identity, MVIEW, sheets or plot expansion; COMPAT-CAD-013 owns that work.
No broad command-language/options/aliases/help expansion; COMPAT-CAD-014 owns that work.
No generalized undo/redo, cancellation or long-session expansion; COMPAT-CAD-015 owns that work.
No BIM completion expansion; COMPAT-CAD-016 owns that work.
No broad OSNAP/OTRACK/tracking/measurement program expansion; COMPAT-CAD-018 owns that work.
No architecture change without an approved ACR.
No benchmark score increase without a measured full-corpus rerun.
risk_assumptions: COMPAT-CAD-009 is the immediately preceding legal dependency and is VERIFIED at physical product merge 066be5fc098443e21263ed57d21788849a875195.
The existing canonical geometry, revision, selection, provenance and rendering foundations are sufficient for the bounded CC010 capability.
Transient previews remain presentation state until canonical commit.
Inspection and dimension calculations must expose supported/unsupported boundaries explicitly rather than fabricating measurements.
Existing verified predecessor invariants remain mandatory regression contracts.
Any native engine requirement remains behind EngineAdapterBundle and does not become application authority.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic automated tests for hatch, annotation, dimension and bounded inspection semantics, invalid/unsupported cases and mutation safety.
Web/Electron semantic parity evidence over the affected command stream.
Regression evidence against COMPAT-CAD-005 through COMPAT-CAD-009.
Independent black-box browser-agent evidence for G1/G4/G6/G8, including negative/error paths.
Revision-bound governance evidence sufficient for an independent Architect to verify the implementation.
